items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: He had a terrible accident where he was invited by Max Roach to come to the Vanguard.

ctx.x: He had a terrible accident, didn’t he?

He had a terrible accident where he was invited by Max Roach to come to the Vanguard. He was staying with his parents. The limo came to pick him up. Now this is kind of sketchy because I’m getting all this second hand. The limo comes, picks him up, brings him to the Vanguard. He’s going around the club and he’s kind of loud and the club ain’t but that big. So they decided he needs to be sent home. He gave the limo driver a hard time coming, so the limo driver said listen, I’m out of here, you take care of him. So…
Right, in a foreign country and the whole thing.
